title: Section — Data Connectors & Sync State
description: State of each connected data source. Policy: connectors sync ONE-WAY into the knowledge base (the canonical model is the single source of truth), prioritizing the last five days of data then backfilling. Outbound (two-way) changes happen only through the user-approved suggestions flow. If the user declines, the dashboard and knowledge base stay correct even when external tools do not align.

name.description: e.g. JobTread, OCR4 Docs, Schedule, Contacts, Email.

last_sync.description: ISO timestamp of last successful inbound sync.

window_days.description: Recent-data window prioritized on each sync.

health.description: green=on track, yellow=team attention, red=priority focus.
